nodes.description: Current version number of the AdventureWorks sample database (technical).
Audit log of DDL changes made to the database (technical, not business data).
Errors captured by the database's error-handling procedure (technical, empty).
Departments (Engineering, Sales, Production, ...) grouped into department groups.
Employees: job title, hire date, demographics, hourly/salaried, vacation and sick leave. Names are in Person__Person (same BusinessEntityID).
Department and shift assignments of employees over time. EndDate NULL = the employee's current department.
Pay rate changes per employee. The current rate is the row with the latest RateChangeDate.
Resumes (XML) submitted by job applicants; BusinessEntityID is set if the candidate was hired.
Work shifts (Day, Evening, Night) with start and end times.
Street addresses of customers, employees, stores and vendors.
Types of addresses (Billing, Home, Main Office, Primary, Shipping, Archive).
Source of the BusinessEntityID shared by people, stores and vendors (the common key for addresses and contacts).
Cross-reference mapping people, stores and vendors to their addresses (with address type).
Cross-reference mapping stores and vendors to their contact people (with contact type).
Roles of business contacts (Owner, Purchasing Agent, Marketing Manager, ...).
ISO country/region codes and names.
E-mail addresses of people.
One-way hashed passwords of people (never select these columns).
Every human known to Adventure Works: employees, sales people, individual customers, store and vendor contacts. Holds names and contact preferences.
Phone numbers of people with phone type.
Phone number types (Cell, Home, Work).
States and provinces with their country and sales territory.
Bill of materials: components required to build each product assembly (hierarchical parent/child).
Languages in which product descriptions are stored. CultureID is padded to 6 characters ('en    ').
Product maintenance documents (hierarchical folders and documents).
Bicycle assembly diagrams (XML).
Inventory and manufacturing locations (work centers such as Frame Welding, Paint, Final Assembly, and storage areas).
Products sold or used in manufacturing: bikes, components, clothing and accessories, with pricing, cost, attributes and lifecycle dates.
Top level of the product hierarchy: Bikes, Components, Clothing, Accessories.
History of product standard costs (StartDate/EndDate; EndDate NULL = current). Use for period-accurate cost of goods.
Product descriptions (marketing text) in several languages.
Cross-reference mapping products to related documents.
Current inventory quantity of each product per location (shelf/bin).
History of product list prices (StartDate/EndDate; EndDate NULL = current).
Product models: a model groups product variants (sizes/colors), e.g. 'Mountain-100'.
Cross-reference mapping product models to illustrations.
Cross-reference mapping product models to their descriptions per language (CultureID is space padded, e.g. 'en    ').
Product images (thumbnail and large photo blobs).
Cross-reference mapping products to their photos.
Customer reviews of products.
Second level of the product hierarchy (e.g. Mountain Bikes, Road Bikes, Helmets, Jerseys). Each belongs to one ProductCategory.
Manufacturing failure (scrap) reasons.
Inventory transactions (sales, purchases, work orders) from 2024-07-30 onward. Older transactions are in Production__TransactionHistoryArchive; UNION ALL both for full history.
Inventory transactions before 2024-07-30 (archive of Production__TransactionHistory, same columns).
Unit of measure lookup. Codes are space padded to 3 characters ('EA ', 'LB ', 'CM ').
Manufacturing work orders: product, quantity to build, scrapped quantity and dates.
Manufacturing steps (routing) of each work order: location, planned vs actual dates, hours and cost.
Which vendors supply which products, with lead time, prices and order quantity limits.
Purchase order lines (products ordered from vendors).
Purchase orders to vendors: vendor, employee who created it, status, dates, shipping and totals.
Shipping companies/methods used for sales and purchase orders.
Companies from which Adventure Works purchases parts and other goods.
Cross-reference mapping countries/regions to their ISO currency codes.
Customer credit card information.
Lookup of ISO currency codes and names.
Daily currency exchange rates from USD to other currencies.
Customers. A customer is either an individual consumer (PersonID set, StoreID NULL) or a reseller store (StoreID set; PersonID is then the store contact, if any).
Cross-reference mapping people to their credit cards.
Individual products (order lines) of each sales order: product, quantity, unit price, discount and line total.
General sales order information: one row per customer order, with dates, customer, channel, sales person, territory, addresses, payment and order totals.
Cross-reference mapping sales orders to the purchase reasons given (online orders).
Sales representatives (employees) with their territory, quota, bonus, commission and year-to-date sales. Names are in Person__Person (same BusinessEntityID).
Sales quota history per sales person and quota date (quarterly quotas).
Lookup of reasons customers give for a purchase (price, promotion, advertising, quality, ...).
Tax rates per state/province.
Sales territories: 5 US regions (Northwest, Northeast, Central, Southwest, Southeast) plus Canada, France, Germany, Australia and United Kingdom, grouped into North America, Europe and Pacific.
History of sales person assignments to territories (StartDate/EndDate; EndDate NULL = current).
Online shopping cart contents until the order is submitted or cancelled (only test rows here).
Promotions and discounts (volume discounts, seasonal sales, clearance, etc.).
Cross-reference of which products are eligible for which special offers.
Reseller customers: bike shops that buy Adventure Works products for resale.
Employees, departments, department/shift history, pay history and job candidates.
People and business entities with their addresses, e-mail, phones, contact roles, countries and states/provinces.
Products and their category hierarchy, models, descriptions and photos, bill of materials, inventory, work orders/routing (manufacturing), cost/price history and inventory transactions.
Vendors, the products they supply, purchase orders and shipping methods.
Customers (individuals and reseller stores), sales orders and lines, sales people and quotas, territories, special offers, currencies, credit cards and sales tax.
Technical tables: build version, DDL audit log and error log. Not business data.
Net sales excluding tax and freight. Order level: SUM(SubTotal). Line level (by product): SUM(LineTotal) - both give the same total.
Amount invoiced to customers including tax and freight.
Number of sales orders.
Number of product units sold.
Net sales revenue divided by number of orders.
Value of price discounts granted on order lines.
Approximate: line revenue minus quantity x current standard cost. For period-accurate cost use Production__ProductCostHistory.
Amount ordered from vendors excluding tax and freight; usually exclude rejected orders (Status = 3).
Units currently in stock, summed over all locations.
Share of work-order quantity that failed inspection.
Sales person year-to-date sales divided by their sales quota.
A Sales__Customer with PersonID set and StoreID NULL (Person__Person.PersonType = 'IN'). Buys online (OnlineOrderFlag = '1').
A Sales__Customer with StoreID set; the store name is Sales__Store.Name. Reseller orders are placed by a sales person (OnlineOrderFlag = '0').
Online/internet channel = OnlineOrderFlag = '1' (individual customers, no sales person). Reseller channel = OnlineOrderFlag = '0' (stores, with SalesPersonID).
Production__ProductCategory (Bikes, Components, Clothing, Accessories) -> Production__ProductSubcategory -> Production__Product. Products without a subcategory are internal components.
Sales__SalesTerritory."Group" groups territories into North America, Europe and Pacific; Name is the territory (5 US regions or a country).
The HumanResources__EmployeeDepartmentHistory row with EndDate IS NULL.
Per employee, the HumanResources__EmployeePayHistory row with the latest RateChangeDate (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BusinessEntityID ORDER BY RateChangeDate DESC) = 1).
Production__TransactionHistory holds transactions from 2024-07-30; Production__TransactionHistoryArchive holds earlier ones. UNION ALL both tables for complete history.
Product with FinishedGoodsFlag = '1'. MakeFlag = '1' means manufactured in-house, '0' purchased.
Product still for sale: SellEndDate IS NULL and DiscontinuedDate IS NULL.
Shared identity (BusinessEntityID) of every person, store and vendor; addresses and contacts hang off it.
Any human known to Adventure Works: employees, sales people, individual customers and store/vendor contacts.

edges.join: FROM Sales__Customer s JOIN Sales__SalesOrderHeader o ON o.CustomerID = s.CustomerID
edges.description: A customer places sales orders.

edges.join: FROM (SELECT * FROM Sales__Customer WHERE StoreID IS NULL) s JOIN (SELECT * FROM Sales__SalesOrderHeader WHERE OnlineOrderFlag = '1') o ON o.CustomerID = s.CustomerID
edges.description: Consumers order online.

edges.join: FROM (SELECT * FROM Sales__Customer WHERE StoreID IS NOT NULL) s JOIN (SELECT * FROM Sales__SalesOrderHeader WHERE OnlineOrderFlag = '0') o ON o.CustomerID = s.CustomerID
edges.description: Store accounts order through sales people.

edges.join: FROM (SELECT * FROM Sales__Customer WHERE StoreID IS NULL) s JOIN Person__Person o ON s.PersonID = o.BusinessEntityID
edges.description: The person behind an individual customer account (name, demographics).

edges.join: FROM (SELECT * FROM Sales__Customer WHERE StoreID IS NOT NULL) s JOIN Sales__Store o ON s.StoreID = o.BusinessEntityID
edges.description: The reseller store a customer account belongs to.

edges.join: FROM Sales__Customer s JOIN Sales__SalesTerritory o ON s.TerritoryID = o.TerritoryID
edges.description: Territory where the customer is located.

edges.join: FROM Sales__SalesOrderHeader s JOIN Sales__SalesTerritory o ON s.TerritoryID = o.TerritoryID
edges.description: Territory in which the sale was made.

edges.join: FROM Sales__SalesOrderHeader s JOIN Sales__SalesPerson o ON s.SalesPersonID = o.BusinessEntityID
edges.description: Sales person who took a reseller order (online orders have none).

edges.join: FROM Sales__SalesOrderHeader s JOIN Sales__SalesOrderDetail o ON o.SalesOrderID = s.SalesOrderID
edges.description: Order lines of a sales order.

edges.join: FROM Sales__SalesOrderHeader s JOIN Sales__SalesOrderDetail v1 ON v1.SalesOrderID = s.SalesOrderID JOIN Production__Product o ON v1.ProductID = o.ProductID
edges.description: Products sold on an order (through its order lines).

edges.join: FROM Sales__SalesOrderDetail s JOIN Production__Product o ON s.ProductID = o.ProductID
edges.description: Product sold on an order line.

edges.join: FROM Sales__SalesOrderDetail s JOIN Sales__SpecialOffer o ON s.SpecialOfferID = o.SpecialOfferID
edges.description: Promotion applied to an order line (1 = No Discount).

edges.join: FROM Sales__SalesOrderHeader s JOIN Sales__CreditCard o ON s.CreditCardID = o.CreditCardID
edges.description: Card used to pay the order.

edges.join: FROM Sales__SalesOrderHeader s JOIN Sales__CurrencyRate o ON s.CurrencyRateID = o.CurrencyRateID
edges.description: Exchange rate used for non-USD orders.

edges.join: FROM Sales__SalesOrderHeader s JOIN Purchasing__ShipMethod o ON s.ShipMethodID = o.ShipMethodID
edges.description: Shipping method of the order.

edges.join: FROM Sales__SalesOrderHeader s JOIN Person__Address o ON s.ShipToAddressID = o.AddressID
edges.description: Shipping address of the order.

edges.join: FROM Sales__SalesOrderHeader s JOIN Person__Address o ON s.BillToAddressID = o.AddressID
edges.description: Billing address of the order.

edges.join: FROM Sales__SalesOrderHeader s JOIN Sales__SalesOrderHeaderSalesReason v1 ON v1.SalesOrderID = s.SalesOrderID JOIN Sales__SalesReason o ON v1.SalesReasonID = o.SalesReasonID
edges.description: Reasons the customer gave for the purchase.

edges.join: FROM Sales__SpecialOffer s JOIN Sales__SpecialOfferProduct v1 ON v1.SpecialOfferID = s.SpecialOfferID JOIN Production__Product o ON v1.ProductID = o.ProductID
edges.description: Products eligible for a promotion.

edges.join: FROM Sales__SalesPerson s JOIN Sales__SalesTerritory o ON s.TerritoryID = o.TerritoryID
edges.description: Territory currently assigned to the sales person.

edges.join: FROM Sales__SalesPerson s JOIN Sales__SalesTerritoryHistory v1 ON v1.BusinessEntityID = s.BusinessEntityID JOIN Sales__SalesTerritory o ON v1.TerritoryID = o.TerritoryID
edges.description: Territory assignment history of sales people.

edges.join: FROM Sales__SalesPerson s JOIN Sales__Store o ON o.SalesPersonID = s.BusinessEntityID
edges.description: Reseller stores a sales person is responsible for.

edges.join: FROM Sales__SalesPerson s JOIN Sales__SalesPersonQuotaHistory o ON o.BusinessEntityID = s.BusinessEntityID
edges.description: Quarterly sales quotas of a sales person.

edges.join: FROM Person__Person s JOIN Sales__PersonCreditCard v1 ON v1.BusinessEntityID = s.BusinessEntityID JOIN Sales__CreditCard o ON v1.CreditCardID = o.CreditCardID
edges.description: Credit cards on file for a person.

edges.join: FROM Sales__CurrencyRate s JOIN Sales__Currency o ON s.FromCurrencyCode = o.CurrencyCode
edges.description: Source currency of the rate (always USD).

edges.join: FROM Sales__CurrencyRate s JOIN Sales__Currency o ON s.ToCurrencyCode = o.CurrencyCode
edges.description: Target currency of the rate.

edges.join: FROM Person__CountryRegion s JOIN Sales__CountryRegionCurrency v1 ON v1.CountryRegionCode = s.CountryRegionCode JOIN Sales__Currency o ON v1.CurrencyCode = o.CurrencyCode
edges.description: Currencies used in a country.

edges.join: FROM Sales__SalesTaxRate s JOIN Person__StateProvince o ON s.StateProvinceID = o.StateProvinceID
edges.description: State or province the tax rate applies to.

edges.join: FROM Sales__SalesTerritory s JOIN Person__CountryRegion o ON s.CountryRegionCode = o.CountryRegionCode
edges.description: Country of the territory.

edges.join: FROM Person__StateProvince s JOIN Sales__SalesTerritory o ON s.TerritoryID = o.TerritoryID
edges.description: Sales territory covering the state or province.

edges.join: FROM Person__StateProvince s JOIN Person__CountryRegion o ON s.CountryRegionCode = o.CountryRegionCode
edges.description: Country of the state or province.

edges.join: FROM Person__Address s JOIN Person__StateProvince o ON s.StateProvinceID = o.StateProvinceID
edges.description: State or province of the address.

edges.join: FROM Person__Person s JOIN Person__BusinessEntity v1 ON s.BusinessEntityID = v1.BusinessEntityID JOIN Person__BusinessEntityAddress v2 ON v2.BusinessEntityID = v1.BusinessEntityID JOIN Person__Address o ON v2.AddressID = o.AddressID
edges.description: Addresses of a person (home, billing, shipping ...).

edges.join: FROM Sales__Store s JOIN Person__BusinessEntity v1 ON s.BusinessEntityID = v1.BusinessEntityID JOIN Person__BusinessEntityAddress v2 ON v2.BusinessEntityID = v1.BusinessEntityID JOIN Person__Address o ON v2.AddressID = o.AddressID
edges.description: Addresses of a store (main office, shipping ...).

edges.join: FROM Purchasing__Vendor s JOIN Person__BusinessEntity v1 ON s.BusinessEntityID = v1.BusinessEntityID JOIN Person__BusinessEntityAddress v2 ON v2.BusinessEntityID = v1.BusinessEntityID JOIN Person__Address o ON v2.AddressID = o.AddressID
edges.description: Addresses of a vendor.

edges.join: FROM Sales__Store s JOIN Person__BusinessEntity v1 ON s.BusinessEntityID = v1.BusinessEntityID JOIN Person__BusinessEntityContact v2 ON v2.BusinessEntityID = v1.BusinessEntityID JOIN (SELECT * FROM Person__Person WHERE PersonType = 'SC') o ON v2.PersonID = o.BusinessEntityID
edges.description: Contact people of a reseller store.

edges.join: FROM Purchasing__Vendor s JOIN Person__BusinessEntity v1 ON s.BusinessEntityID = v1.BusinessEntityID JOIN Person__BusinessEntityContact v2 ON v2.BusinessEntityID = v1.BusinessEntityID JOIN (SELECT * FROM Person__Person WHERE PersonType = 'VC') o ON v2.PersonID = o.BusinessEntityID
edges.description: Contact people of a vendor.

edges.join: FROM Person__Person s JOIN Person__BusinessEntityContact v1 ON v1.PersonID = s.BusinessEntityID JOIN Person__ContactType o ON v1.ContactTypeID = o.ContactTypeID
edges.description: Role a person plays as a store or vendor contact.

edges.join: FROM HumanResources__Employee s JOIN HumanResources__EmployeeDepartmentHistory v1 ON v1.BusinessEntityID = s.BusinessEntityID JOIN HumanResources__Department o ON v1.DepartmentID = o.DepartmentID WHERE v1.EndDate IS NULL
edges.description: Current department of the employee.

edges.join: FROM HumanResources__Employee s JOIN HumanResources__EmployeeDepartmentHistory v1 ON v1.BusinessEntityID = s.BusinessEntityID JOIN HumanResources__Department o ON v1.DepartmentID = o.DepartmentID
edges.description: All departments an employee has been in (history).

edges.join: FROM HumanResources__Employee s JOIN HumanResources__EmployeeDepartmentHistory v1 ON v1.BusinessEntityID = s.BusinessEntityID JOIN HumanResources__Shift o ON v1.ShiftID = o.ShiftID WHERE v1.EndDate IS NULL
edges.description: Current shift of the employee.

edges.join: FROM HumanResources__Employee s JOIN HumanResources__EmployeePayHistory o ON o.BusinessEntityID = s.BusinessEntityID
edges.description: Pay rate history of the employee (latest = current).

edges.join: FROM HumanResources__JobCandidate s JOIN HumanResources__Employee o ON s.BusinessEntityID = o.BusinessEntityID
edges.description: Employee record of a hired candidate.

edges.join: FROM Production__Document s JOIN HumanResources__Employee o ON s.Owner = o.BusinessEntityID
edges.description: Employee who controls the document.

edges.join: FROM Production__Product s JOIN Production__ProductSubcategory o ON s.ProductSubcategoryID = o.ProductSubcategoryID
edges.description: Subcategory of the product (components without one are internal parts).

edges.join: FROM Production__ProductSubcategory s JOIN Production__ProductCategory o ON s.ProductCategoryID = o.ProductCategoryID
edges.description: Category of the subcategory.

edges.join: FROM Production__Product s JOIN Production__ProductSubcategory v1 ON s.ProductSubcategoryID = v1.ProductSubcategoryID JOIN Production__ProductCategory o ON v1.ProductCategoryID = o.ProductCategoryID
edges.description: Top-level category of the product.

edges.join: FROM Production__Product s JOIN Production__ProductModel o ON s.ProductModelID = o.ProductModelID
edges.description: Model the product is a variant of.

edges.join: FROM Production__ProductModel s JOIN Production__ProductModelProductDescriptionCulture v1 ON v1.ProductModelID = s.ProductModelID JOIN Production__ProductDescription o ON v1.ProductDescriptionID = o.ProductDescriptionID
edges.description: Marketing descriptions of a model in several languages.

edges.join: FROM Production__ProductDescription s JOIN Production__ProductModelProductDescriptionCulture v1 ON v1.ProductDescriptionID = s.ProductDescriptionID JOIN Production__Culture o ON v1.CultureID = o.CultureID
edges.description: Language of the description.

edges.join: FROM Production__Product s JOIN Production__BillOfMaterials v1 ON v1.ProductAssemblyID = s.ProductID JOIN Production__Product o ON v1.ComponentID = o.ProductID
edges.description: Bill of materials: components needed to build an assembly.

edges.join: FROM Production__Product s JOIN Production__ProductInventory v1 ON v1.ProductID = s.ProductID JOIN Production__Location o ON v1.LocationID = o.LocationID
edges.description: Inventory quantity of a product per location.

edges.join: FROM Production__Product s JOIN Production__ProductReview o ON o.ProductID = s.ProductID
edges.description: Customer reviews of the product.

edges.join: FROM Production__Product s JOIN Production__ProductCostHistory o ON o.ProductID = s.ProductID
edges.description: Standard cost periods of the product.

edges.join: FROM Production__Product s JOIN Production__ProductListPriceHistory o ON o.ProductID = s.ProductID
edges.description: List price periods of the product.

edges.join: FROM Production__Product s JOIN Production__ProductDocument v1 ON v1.ProductID = s.ProductID JOIN Production__Document o ON v1.DocumentNode = o.DocumentNode
edges.description: Maintenance documents for the product.

edges.join: FROM Production__WorkOrder s JOIN Production__Product o ON s.ProductID = o.ProductID
edges.description: Product built by the work order.

edges.join: FROM Production__WorkOrder s JOIN Production__ScrapReason o ON s.ScrapReasonID = o.ScrapReasonID
edges.description: Why part of the work order quantity was scrapped.

edges.join: FROM Production__WorkOrder s JOIN Production__WorkOrderRouting o ON o.WorkOrderID = s.WorkOrderID
edges.description: Manufacturing steps of the work order.

edges.join: FROM Production__WorkOrderRouting s JOIN Production__Location o ON s.LocationID = o.LocationID
edges.description: Work center where the step is performed.

edges.join: FROM Production__TransactionHistory s JOIN Production__Product o ON s.ProductID = o.ProductID
edges.description: Product whose stock changed.

edges.join: FROM Production__TransactionHistoryArchive s JOIN Production__Product o ON s.ProductID = o.ProductID
edges.description: Product whose stock changed (archive).

edges.join: FROM Production__TransactionHistory s JOIN Sales__SalesOrderHeader o ON s.ReferenceOrderID = o.SalesOrderID AND (s.TransactionType = 'S')
edges.description: Sales order behind a sales transaction (TransactionType S).

edges.join: FROM Production__TransactionHistory s JOIN Purchasing__PurchaseOrderHeader o ON s.ReferenceOrderID = o.PurchaseOrderID AND (s.TransactionType = 'P')
edges.description: Purchase order behind a purchase transaction (TransactionType P).

edges.join: FROM Production__TransactionHistory s JOIN Production__WorkOrder o ON s.ReferenceOrderID = o.WorkOrderID AND (s.TransactionType = 'W')
edges.description: Work order behind a manufacturing transaction (TransactionType W).

edges.join: FROM Purchasing__Vendor s JOIN Purchasing__ProductVendor v1 ON v1.BusinessEntityID = s.BusinessEntityID JOIN Production__Product o ON v1.ProductID = o.ProductID
edges.description: Products a vendor can supply, with lead time and prices.

edges.join: FROM Purchasing__PurchaseOrderHeader s JOIN Purchasing__Vendor o ON s.VendorID = o.BusinessEntityID
edges.description: Vendor the purchase order was sent to.

edges.join: FROM Purchasing__PurchaseOrderHeader s JOIN HumanResources__Employee o ON s.EmployeeID = o.BusinessEntityID
edges.description: Employee (buyer) who created the purchase order.

edges.join: FROM Purchasing__PurchaseOrderHeader s JOIN Purchasing__PurchaseOrderDetail o ON o.PurchaseOrderID = s.PurchaseOrderID
edges.description: Lines of the purchase order.

edges.join: FROM Purchasing__PurchaseOrderDetail s JOIN Production__Product o ON s.ProductID = o.ProductID
edges.description: Product ordered on the line.

edges.join: FROM Purchasing__PurchaseOrderHeader s JOIN Purchasing__PurchaseOrderDetail v1 ON v1.PurchaseOrderID = s.PurchaseOrderID JOIN Production__Product o ON v1.ProductID = o.ProductID
edges.description: Products ordered on the purchase order.

edges.join: FROM Purchasing__PurchaseOrderHeader s JOIN Purchasing__ShipMethod o ON s.ShipMethodID = o.ShipMethodID
edges.description: Shipping method of the purchase order.

edges.join: FROM Production__Product s JOIN Production__ProductProductPhoto v1 ON v1.ProductID = s.ProductID JOIN Production__ProductPhoto o ON v1.ProductPhotoID = o.ProductPhotoID
edges.description: Product photos are mapped through the product-photo cross-reference.

edges.join: FROM Production__ProductModel s JOIN Production__ProductModelIllustration v1 ON v1.ProductModelID = s.ProductModelID JOIN Production__Illustration o ON v1.IllustrationID = o.IllustrationID
edges.description: Product model diagrams are linked through the model-illustration cross-reference.

edges.join: FROM Production__ProductModel s JOIN Production__ProductModelProductDescriptionCulture v1 ON v1.ProductModelID = s.ProductModelID JOIN Production__Culture o ON v1.CultureID = o.CultureID
edges.description: Language used for a model's product description.

edges.join: FROM Production__Product s JOIN Production__ProductInventory o ON o.ProductID = s.ProductID
edges.description: Current inventory balances for a product across locations.

edges.join: FROM Production__Location s JOIN Production__ProductInventory o ON o.LocationID = s.LocationID
edges.description: Inventory balances stored at a location.

edges.join: FROM Person__BusinessEntity s JOIN Person__BusinessEntityAddress v1 ON v1.BusinessEntityID = s.BusinessEntityID JOIN Person__AddressType o ON v1.AddressTypeID = o.AddressTypeID
edges.description: Address type for an address associated with a business entity.

edges.join: FROM Person__Person s JOIN Person__EmailAddress o ON o.BusinessEntityID = s.BusinessEntityID
edges.description: Email addresses associated with a person.

edges.join: FROM Person__Person s JOIN Person__PersonPhone v1 ON v1.BusinessEntityID = s.BusinessEntityID JOIN Person__PhoneNumberType o ON v1.PhoneNumberTypeID = o.PhoneNumberTypeID
edges.description: Phone number types recorded for a person.

edges.join: FROM Production__Product s JOIN Production__UnitMeasure o ON s.SizeUnitMeasureCode = o.UnitMeasureCode
edges.description: Unit associated with the product size.

edges.join: FROM Production__Product s JOIN Production__UnitMeasure o ON s.WeightUnitMeasureCode = o.UnitMeasureCode
edges.description: Unit associated with product weight.

edges.join: FROM Sales__ShoppingCartItem s JOIN Production__Product o ON s.ProductID = o.ProductID
edges.description: Product and quantity in the cart item.

edges.join: FROM Person__BusinessEntity s JOIN Person__BusinessEntityAddress v1 ON v1.BusinessEntityID = s.BusinessEntityID JOIN Person__Address o ON v1.AddressID = o.AddressID
edges.description: Business entities can have multiple addresses through the address-assignment table.

edges.join: FROM Person__Address s JOIN Person__BusinessEntityAddress v1 ON v1.AddressID = s.AddressID JOIN Person__AddressType o ON v1.AddressTypeID = o.AddressTypeID
edges.description: Address type is assigned to a business entity's address association.

edges.join: FROM (SELECT * FROM Sales__Customer WHERE StoreID IS NOT NULL) s JOIN (SELECT * FROM Person__Person WHERE PersonType = 'SC') o ON s.PersonID = o.BusinessEntityID WHERE s.StoreID IS NOT NULL
edges.description: The reseller customer record may identify the store contact through PersonID.

edges.join: FROM Production__TransactionHistoryArchive s JOIN Sales__SalesOrderHeader o ON s.ReferenceOrderID = o.SalesOrderID WHERE s.TransactionType = 'S'
edges.description: Order behind an archived stock movement; TransactionType says which kind.

edges.join: FROM Production__TransactionHistoryArchive s JOIN Purchasing__PurchaseOrderHeader o ON s.ReferenceOrderID = o.PurchaseOrderID WHERE s.TransactionType = 'P'
edges.description: Order behind an archived stock movement; TransactionType says which kind.

edges.join: FROM Production__TransactionHistoryArchive s JOIN Production__WorkOrder o ON s.ReferenceOrderID = o.WorkOrderID WHERE s.TransactionType = 'W'
edges.description: Order behind an archived stock movement; TransactionType says which kind.
